description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Bulbs that go in the Instrument Cluster.
If you haven’t been able to read your speedometer at night now is the time to fix it.
These are the Main Illumination Bulbs in the Speedometer.
There are Two Main Bulbs in the Speedometer so this will do all of them.
Easy to Change Out!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Bulbs
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
